_metadata.notes: Operational costs for running self-hosted GPU infrastructure. Saudi Arabia specific where applicable.

saudi_arabia.notes: Industrial rate for data centers; commercial rate for office setups. Saudi electricity is heavily subsidized.

pue_factor.notes: Power Usage Effectiveness: multiply GPU power by PUE to get total facility power. E.g., 700W GPU × 1.4 PUE = 980W total

cooling.notes: B200 at 1000W TDP generally requires direct liquid cooling. H100/H200 at 700W can use air cooling but liquid is recommended for dense deployments.

networking.notes: Multi-GPU tensor parallelism within a node uses NVLink (included in DGX/HGX). Cross-node pipeline parallelism benefits from InfiniBand.

dgx_h100_8gpu.includes: 8× H100 SXM, 2× Intel Xeon or AMD EPYC CPUs, 2TB RAM, NVLink switch, 10TB NVMe
dgx_h100_8gpu.notes: All-in-one solution; most expensive but simplest to deploy

hgx_h100_8gpu_custom.includes: 8× H100 SXM baseboard; requires custom server chassis, CPU, RAM
hgx_h100_8gpu_custom.notes: Cheaper than DGX but requires system integration

single_gpu_server.includes: Server chassis, CPU, 128GB RAM, NVMe storage, PSU
single_gpu_server.notes: Add GPU cost on top. Suitable for 1-2 GPU setups.

managed_service_fees.notes: Suggested pricing tiers for your managed service offering

basic.includes: Monitoring, uptime alerts, monthly model updates

standard.includes: Basic + fine-tuning updates, performance optimization, priority support

enterprise.includes: Standard + dedicated engineer, custom model development, SLA guarantees

exchange_rates.notes: SAR is pegged to USD at 3.75

on_premise_monthly.formula: gpu_depreciation + electricity + cooling + networking + storage + rack_space + managed_service

cloud_monthly.notes: Add egress fees ($0.08-0.12/GB for hyperscalers) and storage costs

data_centers_in_region: AWS Middle East (Bahrain) — closest to KSA

regulations.pdpl: Personal Data Protection Law — mandates sensitive data stored in-Kingdom
regulations.sdaia: Saudi Data and AI Authority — governs AI deployment
regulations.global_ai_hub_law: Draft law allowing 'data embassies' — foreign entities can host under their own legal jurisdiction within Saudi territory

gpu_import_considerations.us_export_controls: NVIDIA H100/H200/B200 are subject to US export control regulations. Saudi Arabia is in Tier 2 under the AI Diffusion Rule, meaning GPUs can be imported but with licensing requirements for large clusters.
gpu_import_considerations.alternative_sources: Some organizations source through UAE or other intermediaries
gpu_import_considerations.notes: Verify current export control status before large purchases
